sentences.en: That doctrine will no doubt lead to dismal consequences.
sentences.zh: 那种教条无疑会导致悲惨的后果。

sentences.en: That doctrine will no doubt lead to serious consequences.
sentences.zh: 那种教条无疑会导致严重的后果。

sentences.en: Epicurus laid down the doctrine that pleasure was the chief good.
sentences.zh: 伊壁鸠鲁提出了一种学说，认为快乐是至善。

senses.zh: 教条，教义,法律原则,声明,古语 所教的东西，教育

mnemonic: 词根记忆：doctr（=doct教导）+ine（表抽象名词）→教义
